
### encapsulation with encryption  {.smaller}


* GRE = sends packets as is, setup in advance 
<hr class="vspace" />
* often want to add encryption + authentication
* typically: 

   * TLS-handshake like <i>key exchange</i> protocol to setup conncetion
   * add space for message authentication code, nonce
   * encrypt data with symmetric keys

* example protocols: 

   * IKE (setup/key exchange) + IPsec ESP (actual tunnel)
   * OpenVPN (both)
   * WireGuard (both)
